method: Every listed page opened separately as its full-size PNG through the image viewer and visually inspected for tags, margins, glyphs, clipping and overlap.

observations.details: Result headings, displayed factorial product and footer fit the margins; no overlap or missing glyphs.
Curve equations, rational maps, quotient groups and section maps are readable and contained in the text area.
Dense descent proof and two-column residue table fit without clipping; proof end and footer are separated.
Compatibility proof and C.1.8 heading/display are legible; bottom display remains above the footer.
Class-two section formulas and localization exact sequence fit; mathematical accents and arrows render clearly.
Supports triangle and successive cohomology displays fit; lower exact sequence does not collide with the footer.
Tame map, class-three statement, binomial formulas and lower polynomial display are clear and separated.
Long obstruction formulas and cochain equations are legible and remain inside margins.
K-theory formulas and the twenty-four-class statement are clear; lower invariant equation and proof end fit.
Multi-line inverse isogeny formula and tags (10), (11) are aligned and unobstructed; filenames wrap within the text area.
Tags VX.5 through VX.9 are clear and separate from formulas; product formulas and valuation cases fit.
Section heading, C.2.13 and UF.1 through UF.3 are legible; no clipping.
Dense proof and exact intersection UF.4 are legible; paragraphs and footer are separated.
C.2.14 and FB.1 through FB.4 fit; long collection formula remains inside text margins.
C.2.15 and FB.5 through FB.8 fit; Magnus argument continues clearly without overlap.
FB.9 through FB.12 and FQ.1 through FQ.2 are clear; C.2.16 and C.2.17 headings do not collide with content.
FQ.3 through FQ.7 fit; radical fields, commutator formula and field intersection are legible.
FQ.8 through FQ.13 fit; two-line Hasse bound and invariant displays have readable tags.
FQ.14 through FQ.16 fit; morphism and local limit paragraphs are clear and contained.
C.2.17 proof end and C.2.18 opening are separated; AQ.1 through AQ.3 fit.
AQ.4 through AQ.7, including the longer AQ.6a descent formula, are readable with no tag collision.
AQ.8 through AQ.10 fit; obstruction proof and program paragraph remain above the footer.
Final certificate, open task statements and start of references are clear; no orphaned or overlapping heading.
Final references and page footer are clear; URLs wrap inside margins and no missing glyphs are visible.
